caveats: Synthetic accuracy is measured in a simulated known scene, not in the physical classroom.
Real query scan excluded from occupancy map; reference poses and training poses come from TP1 estimation using the complete group. This is not a fully independent ground-truth evaluation.
Three initial offsets per scan are correlated repeat trials, not independent acquisitions.
Search is local, not global, and thresholds have no probabilistic calibration.
Annealing seeds and repeated offsets are correlated computational trials, not independent acquisitions.
